reference_implementation_a.sql: SELECT s.seller_id,COUNT(l.listing_id) AS unsold_listings FROM sellers s LEFT JOIN listings l ON l.seller_id=s.seller_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=ol.order_id WHERE ol.listing_id=l.listing_id AND o.status='completed') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY s.seller_id

reference_implementation_b.sql: SELECT s.seller_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM listings l WHERE l.seller_id=s.seller_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=ol.order_id WHERE ol.listing_id=l.listing_id AND o.status='completed')) AS unsold_listings FROM sellers s ORDER BY s.seller_id
